description: did:webvh v1.0 log vectors shared by the TypeScript and Python SDKs. Both adapters must reproduce the deterministic logs byte for byte, resolve every resolveOnly log and reject every negative log.

negative.name: tampered-genesis-scid
negative.reason: SCID does not match the genesis entry

negative.name: broken-hash-chain
negative.reason: versionId entry hash does not match the entry

negative.name: unauthorized-signer
negative.reason: entry signed by a key outside updateKeys

negative.name: rotated-out-signer
negative.reason: entry after rotation signed by the previous controller key

negative.name: prerotation-signed-by-active-key
negative.reason: entry after a pre-rotation commitment signed by the key that was active before, not by a committed key

negative.name: prerotation-swapped-update-keys
negative.reason: updateKeys of a pre-rotated entry replaced by a key that was never committed

negative.name: witness-declared
negative.reason: log declares witnesses, which Agent-DID does not support yet; must be rejected without network access

negative.name: missing-proof
negative.reason: entry without a Data Integrity proof
